name: runtmc
caption:
RUN TMC 🎮🏀 Three future Hall of Famers, 72.5 points a night. Then we broke them up.

• 1990-91: Mullin 25.7, Richmond 23.9, Hardaway 22.9 PPG
• The league's highest-scoring trio
• Nov 1, 1991: we trade Mitch Richmond to Sacramento for rookie Billy Owens
• Today: Steph 31.3 PPG through 8 games, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg 21.2 through 10

Should we have kept Run TMC together? 👇

facts.claim: Run TMC (Hardaway, Richmond, Mullin, all Hall of Famers, 3 players) played together from 1989 for two seasons (1989-1991); 1990–91: Mullin 25.7, Richmond 23.9, Hardaway 22.9, 72.5 points as the league's highest-scoring trio; on November 1, 1991 Golden State traded Richmond to the Sacramento Kings for rookie Billy Owens
